question: According to the MUTCD, what exact percentage reduction in crashes is guaranteed by installing a STOP sign or all-way stop control?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not state or guarantee any percentage reduction in crashes from installing a STOP sign or all-way stop control — the premise of the question is not supported by the evidence. Instead, the Manual uses crash-frequency thresholds (numbers of reported crashes over 12- or 36-month periods) as factors in warrants and guidance, and it requires that decisions be based on engineering judgment or an engineering study, with the expectation only that the crashes be "of a type susceptible to correction" by the control — not that a specific reduction is assured. Guidance (recommended): - Minor-road stop control should be considered when, among other conditions, "Crash records indicate that: 1. For a four-leg intersection, there are three or more reported crashes in a 12-month period or six or more reported crashes in a 36-month period... 2. For a three-leg intersection, there are three or more reported crashes in a 12-month period or five or more reported crashes in a 36-month period. The crashes should be susceptible to correction by installation of minor-road stop control." No percentage reduction is stated or guaranteed. Options (permitted): - All-way stop control may be installed where an engineering study indicates, for a four-leg intersection, "five or more reported crashes in a 12-month period or six or more reported crashes in a 36-month period that were of a type susceptible to correction by the installation of all-way stop control" (four or more in 12 months, or five or more in 36 months, for a three-leg intersection). This is a crash-count warrant, not a promised crash reduction. - Other all-way stop warrants (sight distance, transition to signal or yield control at a circular intersection, and 8-hour volume) likewise permit installation based on study findings and contain no crash-reduction percentage. Citations: - Section 2B.11 Guidance §1 (p.78) - Section 2B.13 Option §1 (p.79) - Section 2B.14 Option §1 (p.79) - Section 2B.15 Option §1 (p.79) - Section 2B.16 Option §1 (p.79)
